title: Signs of the Times
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Signs of the times are biblical indicators that call believers to discernment, watchfulness, endurance, and hope as they await Christ’s return. They must be handled by Scripture, not speculation, fear, or date-setting.
summary: Signs of the times are biblical indicators that call believers to discernment, watchfulness, endurance, and hope as they await Christ’s return. They must be handled by Scripture, not speculation, fear, or date-setting.
christFocus: Jesus Christ gives His people warnings and promises so they will remain faithful until He comes. The signs point believers toward readiness, not obsession.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture speaks of signs such as deception, wars, persecution, lawlessness, false prophets, rebellion, and distress. These realities remind believers that the present age is marked by conflict before Christ’s return.

Jesus gives warnings so His people will not be deceived. He repeatedly tells believers to see that no one leads them astray.

Signs must not be used for fear-driven prediction. Scripture calls the church to readiness, endurance, discernment, and mission, not date-setting or sensational claims.

The proper response to signs is to lift up one’s head, hold fast to Christ, proclaim the Gospel, and endure to the end.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people are either consumed by end-times speculation or completely indifferent to biblical warnings. Both responses miss Scripture’s purpose.

This doctrine helps believers stay sober and steady. The Lord has told His people enough to be watchful, but not so much that they may claim control over the timeline.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Test end-times claims by Scripture. Refuse panic, pride, and sensationalism. Watch faithfully, endure suffering, guard against deception, and keep the Gospel central as you wait for Christ.
